BEREAN BIBLE COLLEGE
VETERANS RECRUITMENT PACKAGE - EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

======================================================================================
PACKAGE CONTENTS
======================================================================================

✅ Document 1: STANDARD APPLICATION FORM (HTML)
   - Comprehensive application for all Berean candidates
   - 10 sections covering personal info, spiritual background, and prerequisites
   - Online submission ready

✅ Document 2: VETERANS APPLICATION FORM (HTML)
   - Modified application specifically for military veterans
   - Captures military service details, deployment experience
   - Emphasizes GI Bill benefits and modified prerequisites
   - Online submission ready

✅ Document 3: GI BILL BENEFITS RECRUITING PROGRAM (TXT)
   - Complete recruiting strategy for military veterans
   - 12 sections covering everything from benefits to partnerships
   - Implementation guide for building a veteran recruitment pipeline

======================================================================================
KEY DIFFERENCES: STANDARD vs. VETERANS APPLICATION
======================================================================================

STANDARD APPLICATION:
- Prerequisite: 3-6 months of missionary experience under a career missionary (required)
- Essay: Standard Great Commission prompts
- No military service section
- No GI Bill information
- Application fee: $50

VETERANS APPLICATION:
- Prerequisite: Deployment + missionary experience (modified - partial credit for deployment)
- Essay: Veterans-specific prompts (military → missionary transition)
- Extensive military service section (branch, rank, deployments, awards)
- VA benefits section (GI Bill eligibility, COE, benefits remaining)
- Military chaplain reference (optional)
- Application fee: WAIVED for combat veterans with honorable discharge

======================================================================================
GI BILL BENEFITS SUMMARY
======================================================================================

POST-9/11 GI BILL COVERS:
✓ Full tuition for 3-year program (up to $27,120/year)
✓ Monthly housing allowance ($1,500-$2,500/month)
✓ Books & supplies ($1,000/year)
✓ Yellow Ribbon additional funding (if needed)

FINANCIAL COMPARISON:
Traditional Student: $102,000 total cost, $50K-$80K in debt
Veteran (GI Bill): $0 out-of-pocket, $0 debt, RECEIVES $54K-$90K in housing

RESULT: Veterans graduate completely debt-free AND earn income while attending.

======================================================================================
MARKETING STRATEGY
======================================================================================

TARGET AUDIENCE:
✓ Recently separated service members (all branches)
✓ Combat veterans with deployment experience
✓ Service members with foreign language training
✓ Christian military exploring post-service calling
✓ Veterans currently in community college/Bible college
✓ Military spouses with transferred GI Bill benefits

RECRUITMENT CHANNELS:
1. Military Ministry Organizations (OCF, Cadence, Cru Military, Navigators)
2. Base Chaplains (central installations)
3. Veteran Service Organizations (American Legion, VFW, DAV)
4. VA Transition Assistance Program (TAP)
5. Online (Google Ads, Facebook, YouTube testimonials)
6. Military Publications (Military Times, Stars & Stripes)
7. Missionary Sending Organizations (IMB, OMF, SIM, Pioneers, Frontiers)
8. Christian Military Conferences & Events

KEY MESSAGING:
• "From the Battlefield to the Mission Field"
• "Use Your GI Bill to Become a Missionary"
• "Graduate Debt-Free. Deploy to the Harvest."
• "Your Deployment Prepared You for This"
• "Elite Training for Elite Missionaries"

======================================================================================
COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE
======================================================================================

WHY BEREAN WINS FOR VETERANS:

1. GI BILL APPROVED
   - Most Bible colleges aren't VA-approved
   - Berean: Full tuition + housing covered

2. RECOGNIZES MILITARY EXPERIENCE
   - Deployment = partial credit for cross-cultural prerequisite
   - Security training = an asset for hostile fields
   - Modified prerequisites honor their service

3. INTENSIVE TRAINING MATCHES MILITARY CULTURE
   - Year-round (no summers off)
   - 3 years (accelerated, not 4)
   - Discipline and structure that veterans thrive in

4. MISSIONARY FOCUS (NOT PASTORAL)
   - Veterans want mission fields, not pulpits
   - Training for deployment, not comfortable in churches

5. LANGUAGES FIRST PHILOSOPHY
   - Veterans with DLPT scores already understand language learning
   - Original languages = mission effectiveness

6. SENDING ORG PARTNERSHIPS
   - Clear pathway: Military → Berean → IMB/OMF → Field
   - No ambiguity about post-graduation deployment

======================================================================================
PARTNERSHIP OPPORTUNITIES
======================================================================================

MISSIONARY SENDING ORGANIZATIONS:
Propose partnerships with IMB, OMF, SIM, Pioneers, Frontiers:
- They recommend Berean to veteran candidates
- Berean provides theological/missionary training
- They fast-track Berean graduates through the application process
- Result: Military → Berean → Sending Org → Field pipeline

MILITARY MINISTRIES:
Partner with OCF, Cadence, Cru Military, Navigators:
- Co-host transition events ("From Military to Missions")
- Guest speakers at conferences
- Joint marketing materials
- Referral pipeline

BASE CHAPLAINS:
Establish relationships with chaplains at:
- Fort Bragg, NC (large Christian population)
- Fort Hood, TX
- Camp Pendleton, CA
- Naval Station Norfolk, VA
- Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA

Provide chaplains with Berean brochures for transition counseling.

======================================================================================
MODIFIED PREREQUISITES FOR VETERANS (Summary)
======================================================================================

PREREQUISITE #1: BIBLICAL LANGUAGES (No Change)
✓ 1 year Hebrew or Greek (B or better) - REQUIRED
✗ Military language training does NOT substitute

PREREQUISITE #2: CROSS-CULTURAL EXPERIENCE (Modified)
✓ Combat deployment = partial credit
✓ STILL REQUIRED: 3-6 months under career missionary
✓ Acceptable: Deployment + short-term trip + commitment to complete longer stint

PREREQUISITE #3: ESSAY (Modified)
✓ Veterans-specific prompts:
   - Military cross-cultural experience
   - Warrior → missionary identity shift
   - Evidence of calling
   - Why Berean?

PREREQUISITE #4: RECOMMENDATIONS (Modified)
✓ Supervising missionary (if completed mission work)
✓ Current pastor (REQUIRED)
✓ Military chaplain (OPTIONAL but helpful)

======================================================================================
VA COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS
======================================================================================

TO MAINTAIN VA APPROVAL:
✓ Designate School Certifying Official (SCO)
✓ Track daily attendance for all GI Bill students
✓ Monitor academic progress (2.0 GPA minimum)
✓ Report enrollment changes within 30 days
✓ Submit accurate tuition/fee reporting
✓ Complete annual SCO training
✓ Maintain records for 3 years

SCHOOL CERTIFYING OFFICIAL (SCO):
Dr. Tim James
Email: veterans@bereanbiblecollege.edu
Responsibilities: Certify enrollments, monitor progress, ensure compliance

======================================================================================
WHY THIS MATTERS
======================================================================================

THE OPPORTUNITY:
- Thousands of Christian veterans separate from the military annually
- Most feel called to "do something meaningful" post-service
- Many have cross-cultural experience and language training
- Few Bible colleges recruit them or honor their experience
- Most veterans don't know missionary training is an option

THE GAP BEREAN FILLS:
✓ VA-approved, so GI Bill works
✓ Recognizes military experience as valuable
✓ Intensive training that matches military culture
✓ Clear pathway to mission field deployment
✓ Debt-free education through the GI Bill

THE KINGDOM IMPACT:
✓ Mobilizes trained, disciplined, culturally-aware missionaries
✓ Deploys veterans to hostile fields (they're already comfortable there)
✓ Leverages billions in GI Bill funding for the Great Commission
✓ Honors veteran service by giving them a new mission
